How do I make a swap?
How do I use Mobile Money?
How do I secure my wallet?
From the welcome screen, choose \"Create a new wallet\". Write down your 12 words in order, keep them offline (on paper), then set your PIN. Those 12 words are the ONLY way to recover your wallet.

Home → Send → pick the coin → paste or scan the address → enter the amount (or MAX) → Continue → confirm with fingerprint or PIN. Always double-check the address and network: transactions are irreversible.
Home → Receive → pick the coin → share your address or QR code. Make sure the sender uses the SAME network as shown (e.g. USDT on TRC20).

Swap tab → pick the coin to send and the one to receive → enter the amount (or MAX) → Continue → Confirm. The deposit is automatic and the exchange takes 2–5 min via ChangeNOW. Each pair has a minimum: the app shows it if your amount is too low.
Buying/selling in FCFA via Mobile Money (Orange, MTN, Moov, Wave) is rolling out for the UEMOA zone. Tap \"MoMo\" on the home screen to check availability in your country.
Enable biometrics and auto-lock (Settings → Security). NEVER share your 12 words or PIN — VaultEx will never ask for them. Do your backup from Settings → Backup.
Send: only the network fee, shown BEFORE you confirm. Swap: fees are included in the displayed rate — the \"You receive\" amount is net, no surprises.
I lost my phone, how do I recover my wallet?
Install VaultEx on the new phone → \"Import an existing wallet\" → enter your 12 words. Without those 12 words, nobody (not even VaultEx) can restore your funds: that\'s what non-custodial means.
